description: This file serves as the entry point for a React web application. It initializes and renders the root component `<App />` within a DOM element with the ID 'root'. The file also imports global styles and dependencies necessary for rendering the React components.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root to render React components into the specified DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the root DOM node.
